stem: How did levee failures affect New Orleans after Hurricane Katrina?

options.label: A
options.text: High winds damaged the roofs of many homes and businesses.

options.label: B
options.text: Flood waters entered many homes and businesses.

options.label: C
options.text: Rising temperatures caused widespread power outages.

options.label: D
options.text: The storm surge caused widespread destruction of ships.
